headline: Brief v2.1.1-beta — Clawd Mascot Animations in Brief Code, Clean Work-Only Permissions & Automatic Touch Typing
bullets: Clawd Pixel Mascot GIFs in Brief Code: Added exact pixel-art GIFs of Clawd (pulling out his laptop to code & playing soccer with his ball) perched seamlessly on Brief Code's input bar with daily/random rotation and 1-tap switching.

Clean Work-Only Permission Controls Across All 4 AIs: Regular Chat mode hides Ask for permission / Full access completely across Gemini, OpenAI, Claude & OpenRouter; Work / Brief Code / Task shows strictly Ask for permission or Full access.

Automatic Touch Screen Typing & Ultra-HD brief^Ai Icons: Touch-target highlighting & live letter-by-letter typing run automatically under the hood alongside crisp 1024x1024 white-on-black brief^Ai icons across Windows, Linux & Android.
Global Mandatory Upgrade from v2.1.0-beta: Automatically notifies all Android phones/tablets (Samsung, Honor MagicOS, Pixel), Windows PCs, and Linux desktops to update cleanly to v2.1.1-beta.
